newsitem.title: USA: Ziegler closes leasing unit sale.
newsitem.headline: Ziegler closes leasing unit sale.

text.p: Ziegler Cos Inc, a financial services holding company, said it has closed the sale of its Ziegler Leasing Corp subsidiary to a financial services company. The company was not identified.
The sale is valued at about $17 million, subject to post-closing adjustments.
Ziegler said it expects to realize about $11 million after tax, which approximates the book value of Ziegler Leasing as of September 30, 1996.
Ziegler Leasing leases diagnostic, laboratory and operating equipment to healthcare providers, as well as commercial equipment to manufacturing companies and others.
In 1995, Ziegler Leasing posted revenues of about $10.5 million and net income of $716,000.
